data.narrative:
Rhoman Aerospace, founded by Thomas Youmans and Thomas Callen, is a Seed-stage defense and security company. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 10 private companies and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), spanning the frontier-tech defense sector at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses a $250M total-raised proxy as the base, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $625M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—producing a median valuation of $400M and a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $719M (high), with a median of $512M. The 2.1x spread between low and high reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific multiples and peer selection. Key variables affecting placement within this range include: (1) the appropriateness of the $250M raised proxy as a baseline, (2) whether UFORCE's $1.0B valuation represents an outlier or a justified premium, and (3) the degree to which adjacent-stage Series A comps provide relevant anchoring for a current Seed-stage valuation.
